hard_rules.rule: Stop-loss at entry, no averaging down
Trailing stop 30% below peak (never moves down)
Scale-out 10% of original at each +10% net step
Initials out at +100% net (once per trade)
Entry trigger: 1 eligible tracked-wallet buy (2+ = convergence bonus)
RugCheck pass (score ≤50, no danger, authorities revoked, LP ≥80% locked on AMM)
Narrative score ≥ 60 with X or Telegram (+10 early entry <$500K)
Price impact < 3% both sides (AMM reserves or pump.fun curve)

source_notes: Official Solana mainnet RPC, confirmed signed swaps only. Public endpoint is rate limited; incomplete polls block entries.

DexScreener public API prints: fetched timestamp available, exchange-print timestamp unavailable.
